headlines.text: On a Friday in 2023, back when Hook vs. Ethan Page clashed for the FTW Title in a FTW Rules match, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.50. It was the 10th time the FTW Title had been on the line, a notable milestone for the title. In a rematch under FTW Rules, Hook extended his undefeated AEW record to 25-0, retaining his title after a brawl that spilled through the crowd and up the arena stairs.
Back on this day in 2021, JD Drake made their AEW debut against Darby Allin, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.28.

On this day in 2023, Orange Cassidy vs. Dralistico went to battle over the AEW International Title, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.41. It was the first title opportunity of Dralistico's career. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2023, when Billie Starkz made their AEW debut against Jade Cargill, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 5.14.

It was 2023 when The Lucha Brothers vs. Hobbs & Marshall went to battle over the ROH World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.57. Hobbs & Marshall was challenging for gold for the very first time.
Flash back to 2023, when Darby Allin vs. Lee Moriarty met for the very first time on Rampage, rated 6.67.
